root_cause: The autonomous sender relied on the reply loop to recognise opt-outs but the mail itself never told the recipient how to opt out, so a recipient segment could not responsibly be approved.
fix: Append a plain opt-out sentence to every autonomous mail body at send time; keep recipient authority and suppression gates unchanged.
prevention_rule: No recipient segment is approved for autonomous mail unless the mail itself offers an opt-out that the reply loop turns into an active suppression.
terminal_rule: Merged main, deployed powerhouse-autonomous-outreach, then the next sent mail body contains the opt-out sentence (Gmail readback) and a test reply 'afmelden' creates an active suppression.
